title: Patchwork Heifer Lounge Sweater - WW x TLC Pasture Pieces
description:
A collab with TLC.Pasture.Pieces

These cozy lounge sweaters take one-of-a-kind appliques from Taylor at TLC.Pasture.Pieces and add them to W&W's best-selling lounge sweater style to let the art be worn for 3 sizes! 

About the Art & Artist

  • These one-of-a-kind appliques are wearable art, stitched with heart, allowing you to wear the spirit of the pasture wherever you go.  Each piece is named after heifers and cows that are deeply loved and have left their mark on someone's heart.
  • Appliques are a raw-edge quilting cotton and the edges will fray over time.
  • Taylor suggests turning the sweater inside out for washing to protect the applique.
  • Taylor is a farm-mom from Minnedosa, Manitoba.  She grew up surrounded by cattle, prairie skies, and family.  Her art is inspired by tradition, creativity and the beauty of handmade.  Our families have become friends through 4-H, cattle shows, and bull sales, so this is a dream collab for us.
